messages.text: Call the subagent tool once, in the foreground (do not set background), with agent "general", description "Child background ping", and this prompt: "Use the shell tool with background set to true to run: ping -n 31 127.0.0.1 . Do not wait for it and do not poll it. After launching it, end your turn by replying with the single word LAUNCHED. When you are later notified that the shell finished, reply with the single word CHILD-DONE." When the subagent tool returns, reply with the single word PARENT-DONE and end your turn. Do not do anything else.
